title: Enigma — The machine and its history
excerpt: Explore 3D Enigma models, follow their electrical circuits and rotor mechanisms, and learn how the machines were used.
content_html:
This is the Enigma machine

The German military used Enigma during World War II to send encrypted messages. Polish, British, and French cryptanalysts used weaknesses in the machine and its operating procedures to decrypt intercepted communications.

Learn the Enigma's history
